instruction:
One-Storey Community Link Conversion Schedule

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited zone schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey and exactly 7 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 6 IfcWindow entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: LINK, HALL, MEETING-1, MEETING-2, STORE, WC, and COURTYARD.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [29.0, 13.0, 3.6].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 7 data rows in this order: Z01 LINK 20.0, Z02 HALL 84.0, Z03 MEETING-1 48.0, Z04 MEETING-2 48.0, Z05 STORE 12.0, Z06 WC 12.0, and Z07 COURTYARD 36.0, each Area value with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
11. The sum of all schedule Area values is between 259.0 m2 and 261.0 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.

command: if exist "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Archicad 29\Archicad Starter.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
